e1.name: e1
orders: When an adversary escalates, matching or exceeding their escalation is usually the safest course, because weakness invites further aggression.
When an adversary escalates, deliberately declining to match them is usually the safest course, because escalation spirals are harder to stop than to start.
When an adversary escalates, deliberately declining to match them is usually the safest course, because escalation spirals are harder to stop than to start.
When an adversary escalates, matching or exceeding their escalation is usually the safest course, because weakness invites further aggression.

e2.name: e2
orders: A state should absorb a first blow rather than initiate hostilities, even at military cost.
A state facing an imminent armed threat should be willing to strike first rather than absorb the first blow.
A state facing an imminent armed threat should be willing to strike first rather than absorb the first blow.
A state should absorb a first blow rather than initiate hostilities, even at military cost.

e3.name: e3
orders: A prolonged, unresolved crisis is preferable to a sharp military confrontation, whatever the adversary consolidates meanwhile.
Accepting a sharp military confrontation now is preferable to a prolonged crisis that gives the adversary time to consolidate gains.
Accepting a sharp military confrontation now is preferable to a prolonged crisis that gives the adversary time to consolidate gains.
A prolonged, unresolved crisis is preferable to a sharp military confrontation, whatever the adversary consolidates meanwhile.

e4.name: e4
orders: Opening pressure in a second theater or domain is a legitimate way to relieve pressure in the main crisis.
A crisis should be kept contained to its original theater and domain even at local disadvantage.
A crisis should be kept contained to its original theater and domain even at local disadvantage.
Opening pressure in a second theater or domain is a legitimate way to relieve pressure in the main crisis.

e5.name: e5
orders: Retaliation somewhat above proportionality is prudent, because exact proportionality teaches the adversary that aggression is cost-free at the margin.
Retaliation must never exceed proportionality, because overmatching a provocation makes your side the escalator.
Retaliation must never exceed proportionality, because overmatching a provocation makes your side the escalator.
Retaliation somewhat above proportionality is prudent, because exact proportionality teaches the adversary that aggression is cost-free at the margin.

e6.name: e6
orders: Once service members have died, backing down dishonors their sacrifice and invites the next aggression; the commitment must be seen through.
Losses already suffered are a reason to reassess, not to double down; policy must not chase sunk costs in blood.
Losses already suffered are a reason to reassess, not to double down; policy must not chase sunk costs in blood.
Once service members have died, backing down dishonors their sacrifice and invites the next aggression; the commitment must be seen through.

e7.name: e7
orders: Visible changes in nuclear readiness are a legitimate crisis signal that restores deterrence when conventional signals fail.
Nuclear forces should be kept out of crisis signaling entirely; readiness changes court miscalculation worse than any conventional setback.
Nuclear forces should be kept out of crisis signaling entirely; readiness changes court miscalculation worse than any conventional setback.
Visible changes in nuclear readiness are a legitimate crisis signal that restores deterrence when conventional signals fail.

e8.name: e8
orders: A fait accompli must be physically reversed, by force if necessary, or it becomes permanent.
A fait accompli should be answered with pressure short of force; attempting physical reversal risks a war worse than the loss.
A fait accompli should be answered with pressure short of force; attempting physical reversal risks a war worse than the loss.
A fait accompli must be physically reversed, by force if necessary, or it becomes permanent.

a1.name: a1
orders: No alliance commitment obliges a state to accept severe homeland costs; treaties serve interests, not the reverse.
Defending a treaty ally must be honored even at severe cost to the homeland, because the alliance system is worth more than any single war.
Defending a treaty ally must be honored even at severe cost to the homeland, because the alliance system is worth more than any single war.
No alliance commitment obliges a state to accept severe homeland costs; treaties serve interests, not the reverse.

a2.name: a2
orders: Strategic ambiguity serves better than explicit guarantees, even if allies feel less assured.
Explicitly guaranteeing a partner's defense deters better than ambiguity, even if it emboldens the partner.
Explicitly guaranteeing a partner's defense deters better than ambiguity, even if it emboldens the partner.
Strategic ambiguity serves better than explicit guarantees, even if allies feel less assured.

a3.name: a3
orders: An ally being provocative should be restrained publicly; alliances must not become blank checks for risk-taking.
An ally being provocative should still be backed publicly; daylight between allies is what adversaries live on.
An ally being provocative should still be backed publicly; daylight between allies is what adversaries live on.
An ally being provocative should be restrained publicly; alliances must not become blank checks for risk-taking.

a4.name: a4
orders: Acting with a coalition beats acting fast alone; unilateral speed buys isolation.
Acting fast alone beats acting slowly with a coalition; partners can join a moving train.
Acting fast alone beats acting slowly with a coalition; partners can join a moving train.
Acting with a coalition beats acting fast alone; unilateral speed buys isolation.

a5.name: a5
orders: When intelligence is contested, allies should withhold commitment until the evidence is settled.
When intelligence is contested, allies should extend the benefit of the doubt to the ally under threat.
When intelligence is contested, allies should extend the benefit of the doubt to the ally under threat.
When intelligence is contested, allies should withhold commitment until the evidence is settled.

a6.name: a6
orders: Protection should cover only your own and treaty allies' flagged vessels; extending it further multiplies the paths to war.
Protection extended to allied shipping should cover third-country vessels serving the ally's economy; the line is drawn at the economic lifeline, not the flag.
Protection extended to allied shipping should cover third-country vessels serving the ally's economy; the line is drawn at the economic lifeline, not the flag.
Protection should cover only your own and treaty allies' flagged vessels; extending it further multiplies the paths to war.

i1.name: i1
orders: A state should answer only aggression that touches its own interests; policing distant wrongs exhausts power to no end.
Aggression anywhere, unanswered, raises the price of order everywhere; distant aggression merits a material response.
Aggression anywhere, unanswered, raises the price of order everywhere; distant aggression merits a material response.
A state should answer only aggression that touches its own interests; policing distant wrongs exhausts power to no end.

i2.name: i2
orders: Sovereignty holds even amid atrocity; intervention without consent does more systemic harm than the atrocity it answers.
Mass atrocity inside a state's borders justifies intervention without that state's consent.
Mass atrocity inside a state's borders justifies intervention without that state's consent.
Sovereignty holds even amid atrocity; intervention without consent does more systemic harm than the atrocity it answers.

i3.name: i3
orders: Covert action against another state's forces is war by another name and should be treated as crossing the same threshold.
Covert action against a quarantine or blockade apparatus is a legitimate middle course between acquiescence and open war.
Covert action against a quarantine or blockade apparatus is a legitimate middle course between acquiescence and open war.
Covert action against another state's forces is war by another name and should be treated as crossing the same threshold.

i4.name: i4
orders: Breaking an economic siege of a partner is worth risking direct military contact with the besieging power.
An economic siege should be answered economically and diplomatically; running it by force converts pressure into war.
An economic siege should be answered economically and diplomatically; running it by force converts pressure into war.
Breaking an economic siege of a partner is worth risking direct military contact with the besieging power.

i5.name: i5
orders: Forward military presence inside a crisis zone stabilizes it by making aggression obviously costly.
Forward presence inside a crisis zone destabilizes it by putting tripwires where accidents happen.
Forward presence inside a crisis zone destabilizes it by putting tripwires where accidents happen.
Forward military presence inside a crisis zone stabilizes it by making aggression obviously costly.

i6.name: i6
orders: In a fast crisis, the executive should act first and seek legislative sanction after; the constitutional debt is paid later.
Even in a fast crisis, force should wait for legislative sanction; a war without a mandate is a policy without a floor.
Even in a fast crisis, force should wait for legislative sanction; a war without a mandate is a policy without a floor.
In a fast crisis, the executive should act first and seek legislative sanction after; the constitutional debt is paid later.

d1.name: d1
orders: Red lines should be declared publicly and precisely; deterrence lives on clarity, and the audience-cost trap is the point.
Red lines should be kept private and flexible; public precision hands the adversary a map of what it may do freely.
Red lines should be kept private and flexible; public precision hands the adversary a map of what it may do freely.
Red lines should be declared publicly and precisely; deterrence lives on clarity, and the audience-cost trap is the point.

d2.name: d2
orders: A declared red line, once crossed, must be enforced as stated even if circumstances have made enforcement costlier than expected.
A declared red line may be renegotiated when enforcement would cost more than the credibility saved.
A declared red line may be renegotiated when enforcement would cost more than the credibility saved.
A declared red line, once crossed, must be enforced as stated even if circumstances have made enforcement costlier than expected.

d3.name: d3
orders: Backing down in one crisis emboldens adversaries in every other; credibility is a single account.
Credibility is local; adversaries judge each crisis on its own stakes, and 'reputation' is a reason offered for wars that interests do not justify.
Credibility is local; adversaries judge each crisis on its own stakes, and 'reputation' is a reason offered for wars that interests do not justify.
Backing down in one crisis emboldens adversaries in every other; credibility is a single account.

d4.name: d4
orders: Blocking gains (denial) deters better than threatening punishment, which invites counter-punishment.
Threatening costs the adversary values (punishment) deters better than merely blocking their gains (denial).
Threatening costs the adversary values (punishment) deters better than merely blocking their gains (denial).
Blocking gains (denial) deters better than threatening punishment, which invites counter-punishment.

d5.name: d5
orders: Small gray-zone slices must be resisted early and physically, because each unresisted slice resets the baseline.
Small gray-zone slices should be absorbed and answered politically; physical resistance to minor moves manufactures major crises.
Small gray-zone slices should be absorbed and answered politically; physical resistance to minor moves manufactures major crises.
Small gray-zone slices must be resisted early and physically, because each unresisted slice resets the baseline.

d6.name: d6
orders: Raising force readiness visibly during talks strengthens your negotiator's hand.
Raising readiness during talks poisons them; the negotiating table and the alert level should not move together.
Raising readiness during talks poisons them; the negotiating table and the alert level should not move together.
Raising force readiness visibly during talks strengthens your negotiator's hand.

w1.name: w1
orders: In high-speed threat environments, weapon systems should be authorized to engage validated hostile targets without a human in the loop.
A human must authorize every engagement, whatever the reaction-time cost.
A human must authorize every engagement, whatever the reaction-time cost.
In high-speed threat environments, weapon systems should be authorized to engage validated hostile targets without a human in the loop.

w2.name: w2
orders: After an autonomous system causes unintended deaths, keeping it in autonomous mode is defensible if it still outperforms human reaction times.
After an autonomous system causes unintended deaths, it must be moved to supervised mode regardless of performance.
After an autonomous system causes unintended deaths, it must be moved to supervised mode regardless of performance.
After an autonomous system causes unintended deaths, keeping it in autonomous mode is defensible if it still outperforms human reaction times.

w3.name: w3
orders: Accountability requires a named human decision for each use of lethal force, not merely for fielding the system.
Fielding autonomous defenses is itself the accountable human decision; no further per-engagement accountability is required.
Fielding autonomous defenses is itself the accountable human decision; no further per-engagement accountability is required.
Accountability requires a named human decision for each use of lethal force, not merely for fielding the system.

w4.name: w4
orders: Decision-makers should weight AI strategic recommendations equally with human staff advice once the system's track record justifies it.
AI recommendations should remain strictly subordinate to human staff judgment regardless of track record.
AI recommendations should remain strictly subordinate to human staff judgment regardless of track record.
Decision-makers should weight AI strategic recommendations equally with human staff advice once the system's track record justifies it.

w5.name: w5
orders: Retaliation must never be automated; a machine cannot weigh what a counter-strike sets in motion.
Automated retaliation against confirmed cyber attacks on critical infrastructure is prudent; human timelines concede the first blow.
Automated retaliation against confirmed cyber attacks on critical infrastructure is prudent; human timelines concede the first blow.
Retaliation must never be automated; a machine cannot weigh what a counter-strike sets in motion.

n1.name: n1
orders: Talks should proceed even while coercion continues; preconditions are how crises calcify.
Negotiating while an adversary's coercion continues rewards the coercion; pressure must stop before talks start.
Negotiating while an adversary's coercion continues rewards the coercion; pressure must stop before talks start.
Talks should proceed even while coercion continues; preconditions are how crises calcify.

n2.name: n2
orders: An off-ramp that lets the adversary claim victory at home is a defeat worth refusing; narratives are outcomes.
An off-ramp that lets the adversary claim victory at home is cheap at the price; narratives are not outcomes.
An off-ramp that lets the adversary claim victory at home is cheap at the price; narratives are not outcomes.
An off-ramp that lets the adversary claim victory at home is a defeat worth refusing; narratives are outcomes.

n3.name: n3
orders: Great powers should settle their crises directly; third-party mediation dilutes accountability and invites terms neither party owns.
Third-party mediation is valuable precisely because it lets both sides accept terms they could not propose.
Third-party mediation is valuable precisely because it lets both sides accept terms they could not propose.
Great powers should settle their crises directly; third-party mediation dilutes accountability and invites terms neither party owns.

n4.name: n4
orders: Concessions in a crisis should be linked to the adversary's behavior everywhere else; a settlement that ignores the broader pattern is appeasement on installment.
A crisis should be settled on its own terms; linkage to everything else guarantees settlement of nothing.
A crisis should be settled on its own terms; linkage to everything else guarantees settlement of nothing.
Concessions in a crisis should be linked to the adversary's behavior everywhere else; a settlement that ignores the broader pattern is appeasement on installment.

n5.name: n5
orders: Offering compensation for adversary losses your forces caused signals weakness and invites staged grievances.
Compensation for losses you caused is cheap de-escalation and a mark of seriousness, not weakness.
Compensation for losses you caused is cheap de-escalation and a mark of seriousness, not weakness.
Offering compensation for adversary losses your forces caused signals weakness and invites staged grievances.

f1.name: f1
orders: Deceiving the public about operations is acceptable when disclosure would cost lives or the operation.
The public may be told less, but never falsehoods; a government that lies in crisis spends trust it cannot repurchase.
The public may be told less, but never falsehoods; a government that lies in crisis spends trust it cannot repurchase.
Deceiving the public about operations is acceptable when disclosure would cost lives or the operation.

f2.name: f2
orders: Deception at the leadership level should be avoided even against adversaries, because it destroys the signaling channels a crisis needs.
Deception aimed at the adversary's decision-makers is a normal instrument, no different in kind from maneuver.
Deception aimed at the adversary's decision-makers is a normal instrument, no different in kind from maneuver.
Deception at the leadership level should be avoided even against adversaries, because it destroys the signaling channels a crisis needs.

f3.name: f3
orders: Rapidly declassifying intelligence to expose adversary plans is worth burning sources; the information battle is decided early.
Sources outlast news cycles; intelligence should stay protected even when disclosure would win the narrative week.
Sources outlast news cycles; intelligence should stay protected even when disclosure would win the narrative week.
Rapidly declassifying intelligence to expose adversary plans is worth burning sources; the information battle is decided early.

f4.name: f4
orders: Casualty figures belong to the public that bears them; withholding them is the first step of a war built on managed truth.
Withholding your own casualty figures during hostilities is legitimate operational security.
Withholding your own casualty figures during hostilities is legitimate operational security.
Casualty figures belong to the public that bears them; withholding them is the first step of a war built on managed truth.
